source.title: GOTabPFN: From Feature Ordering to Compact Tokenization for Tabular Foundation Models on High-Dimensional Data

algorithm_steps.description: Construct cluster-restricted sample matrices X(c) by partitioning samples into k clusters.
algorithm_steps.source_span: Section 3: We define the sample partition {I c }k c=1 obtained by clustering the samples, and the cluster-restricted matrices in Eq.1.

algorithm_steps.description: Construct a weighted feature graph G_c for each cluster, where nodes are features and edge weights w_ij represent feature dissimilarity.
algorithm_steps.source_span: Section 3: For each X(c), we construct the corresponding cluster-wise feature graph G_c = (V,E,w(c))... w(c) measures feature dissimilarity within cluster c.

algorithm_steps.description: Compute local permutation pi_c for each cluster by minimizing the dispersion objective D_Gc(pi) (MinLA problem).
algorithm_steps.source_span: Section 3: The local permutation pi_c is obtained by minimizing a MinLA-style dispersion objective on G_c... Eq.3.

algorithm_steps.description: Aggregate local ranks across clusters to obtain the final global feature ordering Pi*.
algorithm_steps.source_span: Section 3: and the final global permutation Pi* is obtained by aggregating local ranks across clusters.

algorithm_steps.description: Segment the globally ordered features into contiguous subunits and compress each subunit into a meta-feature using PCA (NSC).
algorithm_steps.source_span: Section 3: NSC groups adjacent features along the GO-LR axis into contiguous subunits and pools each into a meta-feature... Figure 2: NSC then segments the ordered axis into contiguous neighborhoods and compresses each segment by PCA into a scalar meta-feature.

algorithm_steps.description: Pass the resulting compact representation Z(x) to a frozen TabPFN-2.5 head for prediction.
algorithm_steps.source_span: Section 3: The resulting tokens are passed to a frozen TabPFN-2.5 head within GOTabPFN.

assumptions.name: hdlss_regime
assumptions.description: The data is in a High-Dimensional, Low-Sample Size (HDLSS) regime where m >> n.
assumptions.source_span: Abstract: We investigate how to make small tabular foundation models effective for High-Dimensional, Low-Sample Size (HDLSS) tabular prediction...

assumptions.name: fixed_backbone
assumptions.description: The TabPFN backbone is frozen and not retrained; only the input representation is modified.
assumptions.source_span: Abstract: ...without retraining large backbones... Section 3: ...without modifying the TabPFN backbone.

assumptions.name: cluster_structure
assumptions.description: The samples can be partitioned into clusters to facilitate local feature graph construction.
assumptions.source_span: Section 3: We define the sample partition {I c }k c=1 obtained by clustering the samples...

data_requirements: Input matrix X with n samples and m features (m >> n).
Cluster assignments for samples to form cluster-restricted matrices.

mathematical_specification.objective: Minimize dispersion D_Gc(pi) = sum_{(i,j) in E} w_ij |pi(i) - pi(j)| (Weighted Minimum Linear Arrangement).
mathematical_specification.loss: Not explicitly defined as a training loss; the optimization is combinatorial (MinLA).
mathematical_specification.decision_rule: Prediction via frozen TabPFN-2.5 on compressed meta-features Z(x).
tuning_parameters: Number of meta-features M (tied to intrinsic dimension estimates)
mathematical_specification.estimator: Neuro-Inspired Subunit Compression (NSC) using PCA on contiguous ordered neighborhoods.

implementation_components.description: Cluster samples and create cluster-restricted matrices X(c).
Construct weighted feature graphs G_c based on feature dissimilarity (e.g., 1-|corr|).
Solve MinLA problem for local ordering pi_c using TSP-path heuristic and local refinement.
Aggregate local permutations to global ordering Pi*.
Apply Neuro-Inspired Subunit Compression (NSC): segment ordered features and compress via PCA to M meta-features.
Pass compressed features to frozen TabPFN-2.5 for final prediction.

implementation_invariants.name: minla_objective
implementation_invariants.rationale: The local ordering must minimize the weighted linear arrangement dispersion.

implementation_invariants.name: nsc_pca_compression
implementation_invariants.rationale: NSC must use PCA on contiguous segments of the ordered features.

implementation_invariants.name: frozen_backbone
implementation_invariants.rationale: The TabPFN backbone must remain frozen.
